summary: Build practical Kubernetes operations skills in 5 days. Learn cluster access, workloads, storage, security, and troubleshooting.
lede: Kubernetes cluster operations training covers practical work for teams supporting live or pre-production environments. Learners use kubectl and manifests to inspect clusters, apply access controls, manage workload rollouts, and configure services and persistent storage. They also investigate failures with metrics, logs, and events, and develop incident-response runbooks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who operate, support, secure, and troubleshoot Kubernetes environments in live production or pre-production settings.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of Linux command line, YAML syntax, container basics, and Docker concepts. You should be comfortable reading configuration files and using terminal commands, but you do not need prior cluster administration experience. Coding or programming is not required for completion. The course teaches Kubernetes at the operational application level, with hands-on labs focused on manifests, services, storage, security, and troubleshooting.
